items.text: Henry works as a tour guide in London and has ADHD, a condition that makes daily life more difficult for him. He often forgets things like meetings or keys and struggles to do simple tasks. Henry compares his brain to a tombola game where many random balls come out. These balls sometimes help, but often confuse him. This makes him feel upset and sometimes shy. Even so, Henry says he doesn’t want to change because this is who he is. His family loves and supports him, and they know how much ADHD affects his emotions. Henry hopes his story helps others understand ADHD better. Difficult words: condition (a medical state or illness which affects how your body or mind works), struggle (to have a hard time doing something), confuse (to make someone unable to think clearly or understand something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Henry is a tour guide in London. He has ADHD. This means that his brain works in a different way. Henry finds it hard to remember things like keys or meetings. He says that his brain is like a tombola game where many balls come out. These balls are like thoughts or things he has to do. Sometimes this makes Henry feel sad or upset . But Henry says he is okay and does not want to change. His family loves him and helps him a lot. Henry wants people to understand what ADHD is like. Difficult words: tour guide (a person who shows tourists around a place), thought (an idea in your mind), upset (feeling sad and worried). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tourism is facing many challenges today because of political tensions and economic uncertainty between countries like Europe and the USA. These problems make people unsure about their travel plans, which affects the travel industry. However, Europe remains a popular place for visitors, especially for Europeans who travel a lot within the continent. Around 85% of tourism in Europe is inter-European , while 15% comes from long-distance travelers from places like the USA, China, and Latin America. These travelers often visit less known destinations, which helps reduce overcrowding in popular spots. Tourism also plays an important role in the economy of many European countries, contributing around 10% to the European GDP, and even more in some regions. Despite the challenges, tourism is still growing, especially after COVID-19, but people are changing how they travel and spend money. Rising costs, currency changes, and environmental concerns also influence travel patterns. Europe is working to attract visitors from Asia and diversify its tourism markets to keep growing. Difficult words: uncertainty (not being sure about something), inter-European (between European countries), diversify (to make something more varied or different). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Tourism is having problems because of political fights and money issues between Europe and the USA. People are worried and don’t want to book trips easily. Most tourists in Europe are Europeans visiting other countries in Europe. About 85% of trips are inside Europe, and 15% come from faraway countries like the USA and China. These visitors often choose smaller places to visit, which helps with too many tourists in popular cities. Tourism is very important for some countries because it helps the economy. Even though people travel less because of money and environment worries, tourism is still growing after COVID. Europe tries to attract visitors from Asian countries like Japan and India. It also tries to find new ways to get tourists, not only from big countries but from many places. Difficult words: political (about government and countries), environment (the natural world). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tourism has some problems now because countries like Europe and the USA do not get along well. People are afraid to travel. Most people who visit Europe come from other European countries. Only a few come from faraway places like the USA or China. Some visitors like to see small towns, not big cities. Tourism helps countries by giving money to them. Even if people worry about money and nature, many still want to travel after COVID. Europe wants to have more visitors from Asia, like Japan and India. It tries to find many tourists from different countries, not just one or two. Difficult words: afraid (worried), get along (to be friends with someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two high schools in Edinburgh, Portobello High School and Queensferry High School, are the first in Scotland to ban mobile phones. Portobello had already started the new rule, and Queensferry began on May 14. Under the new policy, students from S1 to S6 must place their phones in special magnetic-lock pouches at the beginning of the school day. These pouches stay with the students, but they cannot open them until the end of the school day. The decision to become phone-free was made after six months of discussions with students, parents, and carers. Focus groups met to discuss the idea, and 66% of parents from Portobello High School supported it. The schools wanted to make sure families agreed before starting this change. The policy aims to improve the learning environment and engagement . It is hoped that removing the distraction of phones will help students pay more attention in class and spend less time on notifications or messages. Difficult words: S1 – S6 (six years of secondary school education in Scotland, usually for children who are 12 – 18 years old), engagement (talking and working with others to make a decision), distraction (something that stops you from paying attention). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Two schools in Edinburgh, Portobello and Queensferry High Schools, are the first in Scotland to stop students from using phones at school. Portobello started the rule earlier, Queensferry began on May 14. Every student from S1 to S6 puts their phone in a special bag at the start of the school day. These bags lock with a magnet . Students keep the bag with them, but they cannot use their phones until the school day ends. The schools talked to students, parents, and carers for six months before they made this new rule. Most parents at Portobello liked the idea. The schools hope the rule will help students stay focused and not look at their phones in class. Difficult words: S1 to S6 (six years of secondary school in Scotland, for children who are 12 – 18 years old), magnet (a thing which pulls some metals), focused (giving all attention to something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two schools in Edinburgh say no to phones at school. They are Portobello and Queensferry High Schools. Portobello starts earlier. Queensferry starts on May 14. Students from S1 to S6 put their phones in a special bag in the morning. The bag has a magnet lock. Students keep the bag but cannot open it. Teachers and parents talk for many months. Most parents at Portobello say yes to the new phone rule . The schools want students to look at the teacher and not the phone. It is better for the teacher and for the students, too, because they learn more. Difficult words: S1 to S6 (six years of secondary school in Scotland, for children who are 12 – 18 years old), magnet (a thing which pulls some metals), rule (something what people must or must not do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Flying private jets is very expensive and harmful to the environment. In one year, a renowned musician flew 396 times in their jet, with one flight lasting only six minutes. Renting a jet costs between 7,500 and 17,000 dollars per hour, while buying one can cost up to 65 million dollars. Owners must also pay for fuel, crew, maintenance , and storage, which adds millions more each year. Private jets also produce much more CO2 than commercial flights. Although commercial planes emit a lot of carbon, they carry many people, so the emissions are shared. A private jet, with only a few passengers, emits 10 to 20 times more per person. Just the ten top US private fliers in 2023 caused more emissions than 6,500 people. To reduce emissions, scientists support using Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs). SAFs are made from waste or plants and pollute much less than fossil fuels. If rich private fliers started using them, they could help fund cheaper, cleaner air travel for everyone. Difficult words: renowned (famous or well-known), maintenance (taking care of something regularly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Private jets are expensive and harmful to the planet. One famous musician used a private jet 396 times in one year. Even a short flight can cost a lot of money. Renting a jet costs between 7,500 and 17,000 dollars an hour. Buying one costs millions of dollars, and owners must also pay for fuel and other things. Private jets also make much more pollution than regular planes. Normal planes carry many people, so the pollution is shared . A private jet carries only a few people, so each person causes more damage. Some rich people fly a lot, and cause more pollution than thousands of people who fly in one jet. One way to help is to use better fuel. Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) comes from old food oil and plants. It still makes pollution, but much less. Rich people could use SAF and help pay to make it cheaper for all. Difficult words: rent (to pay money to use something for a short time), owner (a person who has something and it belongs to them), share (to use something together with other people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Private jets are very costly . One music star uses a jet 396 times in one year. A short trip can cost a lot of money. Renting a jet costs between 7,500 and 17,000 dollars for one hour. Fuel , pilot, and fixing the plane also cost more. Private jets are bad for the air. They make more dirty air than big planes. Big planes take many people. A private jet takes only a few. This makes more dirty air for each person. Some rich people fly many times. They hurt the air more than many other people. New fuel can help. It comes from old food oil and plants. It is better for the air. But this fuel is expensive. Rich people can use this fuel to help the planet. Difficult words: costly (expensive), fuel (things like gas or oil which make machines work), fix (to make something work again when it is broken). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Five years after the murder of George Floyd by Minneapolis police, questions remain about progress on racial justice. The video of Floyd’s death sparked protests and global outrage, leading to new efforts for change. Marc Morial, President of the National Urban League, says important steps were made, but recent developments are threatening that progress. The new administration has frozen all civil rights investigations, which he says could erode what has been achieved. A recent report, George Floyd Five Years Later, shows that while some companies have kept their diversity commitments , many have made only cosmetic changes or stepped back. Police reform and training have improved in some cities, but the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act has still not passed. Morial believes the fight for fairness is not over. Local governments, police, and community leaders still have the chance to create change. But the fear is that without strong support, old problems will remain, and progress will stop. Difficult words: erode (gradually weaken or destroy), commitment (a promise or strong decision to do or support something), cosmetic (made to look better on the outside, but not a real or deep change). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Five years after George Floyd died, people want to know if things got better. Marc Morial from the National Urban League says some good things happened, but now they are in danger. The government stopped all civil rights work, which is a problem. After Floyd’s death, many protests called for changes. Some companies keep helping diversity , but some stopped. Morial says diversity means giving everyone a chance to get a job or go to school. Police get more training, but still need to do better. Police now help with more problems like family fights and health issues. The work for justice doesn’t end. Some cities and states work on changes because the national government is slow. Morial wants tax laws that help people who earn less money. Difficult words: civil rights (when all people are treated the same and fair), diversity (different kinds of people), justice (fairness). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

George Floyd dies five years ago. Many people want to know if things are better now. Marc Morial says some things are better, but some are worse. The government stops work about civil rights . People ask for change after Floyd dies. Some companies help, some do not. Diversity means giving a chance to all people. Police learn new things but still need to do better. Police help with problems like sick people or fights at home. But the work is not finished. Cities try to change the rules because the government is slow. Morial wants a new law to help people with less money. Difficult words: civil rights (when all people are treated the same and fairly), law (rules). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Traffic on Highway 400 in Ontario, Canada, was heavily delayed due to a herd of cows that escaped and wandered onto the road. The highway connects Toronto to Cottage Country, and many people were using it for the first long weekend of summer. The cows were first seen near Aurora Road and moved several kilometers, causing danger to both animals and drivers. Police officers and farmers worked together to guide the cows off the road and into trailers . Some were captured, but a few were still loose . According to Sergeant Kerry Schmidt, the cows may have been frightened by thunder and lightning during the night. They broke out of their enclosure and began wandering. Some cows entered construction zones, moved in different directions, and even charged at people and vehicles. Officers had to dive for safety several times. Animal welfare groups are helping, and one farmer was injured. Everyone is working hard to protect the cows and prevent accidents, especially before nightfall when visibility becomes poor. Difficult words: trailer (a large container pulled by a car or truck), loose (free to move around), charge (to run quickly at someone or something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

There was a big traffic problem on Highway 400 in Ontario, Canada. A group of cows walked onto the highway, where many people drove to their cottages for the long weekend. Police and farmers worked hard to get the cows off the road and into trailers . Some cows were already safe, but a few were still running. Sergeant Schmidt said the cows got scared during a storm with thunder and lightning. They escaped from their field and went onto the road. Some cows ran in different directions and even ran toward cars and people. This made it dangerous for everyone. Animal workers and farmers are helping now. One farmer got hurt, but the police are trying to keep the cows and drivers safe. They hope to stop the cows from going back on the road. Difficult words: highway (a big road with fast cars), trailer (a big box pulled by a car or truck), direction (the way someone or something goes or faces). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many cows walk on a big road in Canada. This road is very busy. Many people drive to their holiday homes. The cows walk for a long time. Police and farmers try to help them. They get some cows into a trailer . Some cows are not in the trailer yet. One police officer says that the cows are afraid. There is a storm with loud noise at night. The cows run away from their farm. They walk on the road. Some cows run near cars and people. This is not safe. The cows are tired . One farmer is hurt. Animal helpers are with the police. They want to help the cows and the people. They want no more problems. Difficult words: trailer (a big box which a car or truck pulls to carry animals or things), storm (rain with wind and loud sound), tired (without energy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Cannes Film Festival opened with not only stars and glamour but also a focus on Gaza. French actress Juliette Binoche paid tribute to Fatima Hassouna, a young Palestinian photojournalist who was killed in an Israeli airstrike last month. Fatima was featured in a documentary shown at the festival. Her death, just a day after hearing about the film’s screening, deeply moved many people. Many actors and filmmakers signed an open letter asking for an end to the violence in Gaza. Some also questioned Juliette Binoche for not signing it. During her speech, she said that art stays alive even when people are gone and that it tells our stories and dreams. The festival organizers usually try to avoid politics, but the current global situation made that impossible. The festival also showed support for Ukraine by screening documentaries. Films from other countries like Iran, Japan, and the US are also in the competition, keeping Cannes a truly international event. Difficult words: glamour (excitement and attractiveness), tribute (an act of respect or honor). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Cannes Film Festival started with many famous actors walking on the red carpet. But this year, there was also talk about war and politics. French actress Juliette Binoche spoke about Fatima Hassouna, a 25-year-old photojournalist from Gaza. Fatima died in an Israeli air strike one day after learning that a film with her in it would play at the festival. Almost 400 people who work in film signed a letter. They want to stop the violence in Gaza. Some asked Juliette why she didn’t sign the letter. She said that art can still speak, even when people can’t. The festival also showed movies from Ukraine, Iran, Japan, and the US. Tom Cruise will come to show his new Mission Impossible movie. Cannes is about films, but this year, many people are thinking about world problems. Difficult words: photojournalist (a person who creates news mainly by using photos), violence (actions which hurt people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Cannes Film Festival starts in France. Many actors come and walk on the red carpet. People are happy and take photos. But the festival is not only about movies this year. A woman named Fatima is a journalist in Gaza. She dies in a bomb attack. She is in a movie. This movie is now at the festival. Fatima dies one day after she hears about the movie. Juliette Binoche, a French actress, talks about Fatima. She says that art is strong and tells our stories. Many people also talk about the war. They write a letter to stop the fighting. The festival shows movies from many places like Japan, Iran, and Ukraine. A new Mission Impossible movie will also play. Difficult words: festival (an event with many people and activities), journalist (a person who writes news), war (fighting). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Ocean with David Attenborough is a new film that takes viewers on a journey through the beauty and importance of the sea. The documentary shows that the ocean is not only full of life and wonder but also essential for the survival of our planet. Attenborough shares how his life has matched the era of great ocean discoveries and why a healthy ocean helps keep the Earth stable and rich. The film uses amazing footage to show coral reefs, kelp forests, and the open sea. It reveals serious problems like harmful fishing and coral bleaching , but it also shares hope. Around the world, people are working to help the ocean recover, and Attenborough believes it can return to a better state than ever before. After the main film, viewers can watch A Deeper Dive, a behind-the-scenes feature with extra footage and interviews. The goal of the film is clear: to inspire action and protect our oceans for the future. Difficult words: era (a long period in history), kelp (a large brown sea plant that grows in the ocean), bleaching (loss of color, often caused by stress or heat). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Ocean with David Attenborough is a new movie about the sea. It shows how important the ocean is for all life on Earth. The film has beautiful pictures of sea life, like coral reefs and big open water. David Attenborough tells us that the sea helps keep the world safe and full of life. The film also shows big problems. Some fishing hurts the sea, and some coral is losing color because the ocean is getting warmer. But there is good news too. People are helping, and the sea can become healthy again. The ocean can get better faster than we think. After the movie, there is a second part called A Deeper Dive. It shows more about how they made the film and talks with the people behind it. Difficult words: coral reef (rocks of coral in the sea), healthy (in a good state, feeling well). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

David Attenborough has a new movie. It is about the sea. The sea is big and full of life. It is very important for our world. It keeps the Earth safe and clean. In the movie, we see fish, coral , and other sea animals. David says that we must help the sea. Some people hurt the sea. They catch too much fish. The sea is sick now. But we can help. If we stop doing bad things, the sea can be strong again. It can grow and be better than before. After the movie, we see more. It shows how people make the movie. People talk about the sea and why it is so important. Difficult words: important (something what matters a lot), coral (a sea animal which makes colorful rocks), sick (not healthy, not feeling good). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A fertilizer factory in northern Germany has existed for over 100 years, but its future is uncertain. It made a loss in 2024 and is now working at a lower capacity because of high energy prices. These rising costs and low demand are creating problems for the company, and it is unclear if the business model can still be successful. This problem doesn’t concern only one company. Many German factories are producing less and letting workers go. While Germany has protected industrial jobs more than many other countries, some businesses and whole industries are now at risk. The new government wants to invest more money to support both old industries and new technologies, but it is still unknown if this will work. Germany is one of the world’s top manufacturing countries. It makes products like machines, steel, and textiles. When compared to its size, Germany produces more than many other rich nations. People are now asking how the country can keep these jobs and grow its economy. Difficult words: fertilizer (a substance that makes plants grow better and faster), capacity (the amount something can produce or hold). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A fertilizer factory in Germany is having problems. It started over 100 years ago, but now it is losing money. Energy costs are very high, and the factory can’t make as much as before. This makes the future of the business unclear . Other factories in Germany also have problems. They are making less and cutting jobs. Germany usually keeps many factory jobs, but now it is harder. The government wants to help with more money, but we don’t know if this will work well. Germany is still one of the top countries in the world for making things like machines, steel , and clothes. Even if it is a small country, it makes more than many big countries. People ask how Germany can keep these jobs and grow. Difficult words: fertilize r (a substance which helps plants grow), unclear (not easy to understand or know), steel (hard silver metal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A factory in Germany makes fertilizer . It is very old. It works for over 100 years. Now it has big problems. The factory needs energy to work. But energy is too expensive now. Because of this, the factory makes less. It also does not make money. Other factories in Germany also have problems. They make less than before. Some people stop working. They lose their jobs. This is very hard. The leaders in Germany want to help. They want to give money to the factories. But we do not know if it will help or not. Germany makes many things. It makes machines, clothes, and steel . Germany is small, but it makes more than some big countries. People want to keep these jobs and grow the workforce. Difficult words: fertilizer (a substance which helps plants grow), energy (power for homes and factories), steel (a hard and strong silver metal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Gérard Depardieu, a well-known French actor, has been found guilty of sexually assaulting two women on a film set in 2021. The court gave him an 18-month suspended prison sentence. He also can’t run for election for two years and must be listed in the national database of sexual offenders. The victims were a costume designer and an assistant, aged 54 and 34. Although Depardieu denied the accusations, he admitted to using vulgar language and touching the hips of one woman, claiming it was not sexual. In addition to the sentence, Depardieu must pay the two women 1,000 and 2,000 euros for secondary victimisation . However, he was not fined the 20,000 euros that the prosecutor requested. His lawyer announced that Depardieu will appeal the decision. The case is considered a major test for how France and its film industry deal with sexual misconduct claims after the #MeToo movement. Depardieu has faced accusations from over 20 women. One rape case from 2018 remains active and may go to trial soon. Difficult words: suspended (not active unless another crime happens), secondary (occurring as a result of something else), victimisation (treating someone badly, especially again and again), misconduct (unacceptable or improper behavior). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The French actor Gérard Depardieu was found guilty of sexually attacking two women on a film set in 2021. He received an 18-month prison sentence, but he will not go to prison unless he does something wrong again. He can’t take part in elections for two years and will go on a special list of sex offenders . The two women worked on the film. One was a costume designer and the other was an assistant. Depardieu said he didn’t do anything wrong, but he agreed that he used bad words and touched one woman during a fight. He will pay them 1,000 and 2,000 euros. More than 20 women accused him. Only one case went to court, but another case from 2018 may also go to court soon. Depardieu wants to appeal the court’s decision. Difficult words: guilty (having done something wrong), offender (someone who breaks the law), accuse (to say that someone did something wrong), appeal (to ask a court to change its decision). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Gérard Depardieu is a French actor. A court says he does something bad to two women on a movie set. This happens in 2021. The actor must not go to prison, but he must be careful . If he does something wrong, he will go to prison. He cannot vote or be in election s for two years. He goes on a list for people who do bad things. The women work on the movie. One works with clothes. The other helps on the set. Depardieu says he does not hurt them. But he says he uses bad words and touches one woman. He must give the women some money. Many women say Depardieu does bad things. One other woman says he hurts her in 2018. That case does not finish yet. Difficult words: court (a place where people go when they are in trouble with the law), careful (to focus on what you are doing so that you do not make a mistake), elections (when people vote for someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Amber Heard has shared happy news: she is now a mother of three children. On May 11th, 2025, she announced on social media that she gave birth to twins – a daughter named Agnes and a son named Ocean. She posted a photo of their feet and said this Mother’s Day was very special because her dream of completing her family finally came true. Amber already has a four-year-old daughter, Oonagh Paige. She first revealed she was expecting the twins in December 2024. At the time, a representative explained it was still early in the pregnancy; however, Amber was very happy about it, both for herself and her daughter. Amber has often talked about wanting to build a family in her own way, without following traditional expectations. When she announced Oonagh’s birth in 2021, she also spoke about women choosing motherhood on their terms. She has since shared posts about being both a mother and father to her children, calling herself a multitasking mama. Difficult words: representative (a person who speaks for someone else), multitasking (doing more than one thing at the same time). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Amber Heard is now a mother of three children. On May 11th, 2025, she shared on social media that she had twins – a baby girl named Agnes and a baby boy named Ocean. She showed a picture of their small feet and said this Mother’s Day is very special for her. Amber already has a daughter named Oonagh Paige who is four years old. Amber told people in December 2024 that she was going to have more babies. Her team said she was very happy about the news and excited for her and her daughter. Amber said before that she wanted to become a mom in her own way. When her daughter was born, she spoke about how important it is for women to make their own choices . She sometimes says she is both mom and dad to her kids. Difficult words: twin (one of two babies born at the same time), choice (what you choose to do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Amber Heard has three children now. On May 11th, 2025, she says on the internet that she has twins . One is a baby girl named Agnes. One is a baby boy named Ocean. Amber shows a photo of their feet and says that it is a happy day. Amber also has a big daughter. Her name is Oonagh Paige. She is four years old. Amber says in December 2024 that she will have two more babies. She is very happy. She wants a family. Amber talks about being a mom. She says that she does not need a ring to have a baby. She says she is the mom and also the dad. She calls herself a busy mom. Difficult words: twin (one of two babies who are born together), ring (a small piece of jewelry which you wear on your finger), busy (doing many things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

More students in the US are choosing skilled trades instead of going to college. Many high school students are offered well-paid jobs in welding , plumbing, or similar fields right after graduation. Some of these students can earn more than 50,000 or even 75,000 dollars without a university degree. This is happening because there is a strong demand for workers in these areas. At the same time, more college students are using AI tools like ChatGPT to complete their assignments . Some students admit they don’t write anything themselves, which makes people question the value of a college degree today. Even at top schools, many students feel they learn more from online sources than from their classes. Because of this, experts and companies are starting to promote alternatives to college. They want to bring back shop classes and support programs where students learn real-life skills. These options can lead to good jobs and even help young people start their businesses. Difficult words: welding (joining pieces of metal together with heat), assignment (a task or piece of work given to someone), promote (to support or encourage something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Some students in the US don’t go to college, and they choose jobs like welding or plumbing. These students finish high school and get good jobs. Some jobs give 50,000 dollars or more every year. These jobs are popular because companies need many workers. College students often use AI like ChatGPT for homework. Some students say they don’t write their homework but let the AI do it. This makes people think whether college is still useful. Many students learn more from the internet. Many people now talk about other ways to learn. Some schools want to start shop classes again. Some programs help students learn jobs with their hands. These ways can help students get good jobs and make money. Difficult words: welding (joining pieces of metal together with heat), plumbing (putting in and fixing pipes for water and toilets in homes or buildings), shop class (a school class where students learn to work with tools and materials). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Some students in the US do not go to college . They learn to work with materials. They learn to build and repair things. These students work after school. They get good money. Some get 50,000 dollars every year. College students often use AI. They use it for schoolwork. Some do not write the work at all. They let AI do it. They do not learn much in class. Some people ask what a degree is about these days. Many people say that school is not the only way to get a job. They want to help students learn with their hands. Some schools teach shop class . Some programs help students get jobs. Difficult words: college (a school after high school), degree (a certificate which you get when you finish studying at a college or university), shop class (a school class where students learn to work with hands). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thousands of protesters gathered in Freedom Square in the capital, Bratislava, and other Slovak cities to voice their objection to Prime Minister Robert Fico and oppose his policies. Fico visited the Victory Day parade in Moscow, a major national event, and met Russian President Vladimir Putin. He was the only leader from the European Union to attend the celebrations. People are angry because Fico’s visit is seen as support for Russia, especially while the war in Ukraine is still going on. The protesters shouted that Fico doesn’t represent them and that Slovakia belongs to Europe. Many Slovaks are worried about his political direction, especially his anti-European views and friendly attitude toward Russia. His government has been criticised for having pro-Kremlin opinions and saying negative things about the European Union and NATO. Fico said he wants normal, friendly cooperation with Russia, and earlier, he had spoken with Putin about gas supplies. His political party returned to power in 2023 after winning an election with pro-Russian ideas. Since then, there have been more and more protests against his leadership. Difficult words: voice (to say what you think or feel), objection (a reason why you don’t like or agree with something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many people in Slovakia protested after Prime Minister Robert Fico went to Moscow and met the Russian leader, Vladimir Putin. He was the only EU leader at the Russian Victory Day event . People were angry because the war in Ukraine is still happening. The protesters said that Fico doesn’t show what the Slovak people think. They want Slovakia to stay with Europe and not get closer to Russia. Fico often says bad things about the European Union and NATO. Fico said that he wants good and normal relations with Russia. In 2023, his party won the election with ideas that support Russia. Since then, people in many cities protest to say they don’t like his ideas and plans. Difficult words: event (something important that happens), relation (a connection between people or countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

US President Donald Trump has announced plans to reopen the famous Alcatraz prison located on an island near San Francisco. Alcatraz was designed to hold dangerous criminals and was known for being nearly impossible to escape from. However, the prison closed in 1963 because it was too expensive to run. Today, the island is a museum and a popular tourist attraction. Trump believes that reopening Alcatraz would help solve the issue of overcrowded prisons in the United States. He is ordering a large investment to restore and expand the prison. Many experts disagree with this plan, arguing that it is unrealistic and based on political reasons rather than practical solutions. They say there are better ways to address crime and prison issues, such as focusing on reform and rehabilitation . Difficult words: restore (to make something return to its original condition), address (to deal with something), rehabilitation (the process of helping someone return to society after prison). Brazilian police stopped a planned bomb attack at Lady Gaga’s concert on Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro. The concert took place on Saturday and was free to attend. More than two million people gathered to see the singer perform. Authorities said the attack was organized by a group that promotes hate speech and tries to radicalize young people. The suspects had recruited others, including teenagers, to help with the plan. They wanted to use homemade explosives and Molotov cocktails . Their goal was to gain attention on social media and become more well-known. The main person behind the plan was arrested, and a teenager was also caught. The police acted in coordination with the Justice Ministry. According to officials, the people behind the attack claimed to be part of Lady Gaga’s fan group, known as the Little Monsters. If the plan had succeeded, it could have caused a tragedy at the large concert. Fortunately, the authorities acted in time and prevented any harm. Difficult words: radicalize (to make someone support extreme ideas), Molotov cocktail (a simple bomb made by putting a flammable liquid into a glass bottle and lighting it before throwing it), coordination (working together in an organized way to do something). India has launched a military operation called Operation Sindoor targeting terrorist bases in Pakistan and Pakistan-administered Kashmir. According to the Indian government, these sites were used to plan attacks against India, including a recent deadly attack on tourists in Kashmir. India says it was careful not to hit Pakistani military sites and aimed to avoid making the situation worse. The action, they claim, was focused and limited in nature . Explosions were reported in several areas, and power outages occurred in some places. Pakistan’s military confirmed the strikes and strongly condemned them, calling them cowardly . Pakistan also stated that its air force jets were flying and would choose the right time and place to respond. Relations between the two nuclear-armed nations have been very tense, especially after last month’s attack. Both countries have a long history of conflict, particularly over Kashmir. Now the world is watching to see if things will calm down or escalate further. Difficult words: in nature (in the type of character; what something is like), cowardly (showing fear or lack of courage), escalate (to make a problem or fight worse). Anthony Albanese has won re-election as Australia’s prime minister, defeating the conservative leader Peter Dutton in a major landslide . This is the first time in over 20 years that a prime minister has won two elections in a row. Albanese’s Labor Party is expected to win around 85 seats, well above the 76 needed for a majority. Peter Dutton not only lost the election but also his seat after 24 years. Experts say his campaign, which copied some ideas from Donald Trump’s policies, started strong but lost support after Trump’s tariffs raised concern among Australian voters. In contrast, Albanese focused on popular issues like healthcare, clean energy, and the rising cost of living. His team also targeted younger voters, who now outnumber baby boomers , by using podcasts and social media. Now that Labor has won big, they must keep their promises to maintain support. One challenge for both major parties is that about a third of voters chose independents or smaller parties, showing that many Australians want something different. Difficult words: landslide (big win), outnumber (to be more in number than someone or something else), baby boomer (a person born between 1946 and 1964). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Internet Archive is a non-profit organization in San Francisco that works to save the history of the Internet. It keeps snapshots of websites over time, acting like a time machine for the web. The Wayback Machine is one of its main tools, allowing users to see past versions of websites. It constantly scans the internet, which changes every day. The Archive also stores physical items like books, music, and videos, which are later digitized . Founder Brewster Kahle and director Mark Graham believe it is important to save this information for future generations. Some users, like former Air Force engineer Jessica Peterson, are grateful that the Archive saved material the government removed. She found her deleted videos through the Wayback Machine. Recently, the Archive faced political pressure after some US government websites were taken down or changed during the Trump administration. Experts say the amount of lost content is unusual and concerning. Despite these threats, the Archive continues its work to protect global digital history. Difficult words: snapshot (a photo), constantly (all the time), digitized (turned into digital form). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Kagoshima Prefecture in southwestern Japan is working to expand overseas sales of tencha tea leaves, which are used to make matcha. Matcha is becoming very popular around the world due to its health benefits and antioxidant properties. Kagoshima grows the most unrefined tea leaves in Japan and is increasing production to meet global demand. Farmer Kamimuro Kazuhisa from Shibushi City used to grow regular green tea, sencha. But due to falling prices, he switched to tencha, which sells for double the price. Growing tencha requires special care, including covering tea plants from sunlight for three weeks. Kamimuro invested 1.4 million dollars in special equipment to dry the leaves. Overseas interest in matcha is so strong that orders come in before the tea is even harvested. Despite the high demand, tencha production remains low because few people are entering the market. A local company is helping producers connect with international buyers and hopes to process and export matcha directly from Kagoshima. Difficult words: prefecture (a political region or local government area in some countries), antioxidant (a substance that protects the body from damage), unrefined (in a natural state, without having been through a chemical or industrial process). Green Day received their star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on May 1, 2025. The ceremony took place at 6212 Hollywood Boulevard, where famous guests like Serena Williams and Ryan Reynolds joined the event. The band thanked their fans and expressed their appreciation for their support over the years. They also shared memories from their long career and expressed pride in their friendship and creative journey. Green Day celebrated their recent success by launching a new Slurpee flavor with 7-Eleven. They reflected on their early album, Kerplunk, and promised more shows and music. Their story proves their lasting impact and dedication to music. Formed in 1986, Green Day became one of the most successful punk rock bands in the world. Their album Dookie in 1994 helped bring punk back into the spotlight . Later, their 2004 album American Idiot became a huge hit and was even turned into a Broadway show. In 2024, they released Saviors, which was praised by critics and led to a global stadium tour. Difficult words: dedication (strong commitment to something), spotlight (attention from the public or media). You can watch the video news lower on this page.
